t.A och C startar på vänster sida, B och D: A and C start on the left side, B and D at the sticks, E and F on the other end.

t.A passar B som spelar vägg med C förbi f: A fits B that plays wall with C past the defender.

t.A passar till B och springer mot mål. B: A fits to B and runs towards goals. B plays into the surface.
t.A passar till B som lägger av till C som: A fits to B which adds to C that runs in from the depth.
t.A passar till B, B lägger tillbaka på et: A fits to B, B adds back on a touch, A plays directly to C that started its run in the right time. Rotate positions. Add a passive defender to B.
A is suitable for B, B is suitable for C. C drives along the edge and beats posts. A and B run into the penalty area, one against the front and one against the lower post, and end. Change the place by sun.
t.A passar till B, B till C på kanten. C d: A fits to B, B to C on the edge. C pushes past the stick and beats posts. A and B run into the front and outer post and finish. The coach plays in a return ball. Then the track starts from the other edge.
t.A passar till B, B till C, C ut till kan: A fits to B, B to C, C out to the edge. The edge records against the box where a player from each team meets in 1 v 1. First on the ball strikes against the big goal, the second defends and can contrast with the small goals. Winning teams get 1 point.
t.A passar till B. B lägger av till C som: A is suitable for B. B adds C that comes around the doll. C turns and ends. The same pattern goes the other way. Everyone goes one step further.
t.A passar till B. B lägger till C på väns: A is suitable for B. B adds C to the left. C plays back to A that has run. A strikes out to D on the right. D hits posts while B and C run into the penalty area and ends. Everybody goes a station.
t.A passar till B. B lägger upp till C som: A is suitable for B. B adds up to C coming forward. C hits D. D is back to A that has expired. A hits far to E, and A runs to F. Everybody goes a station.
t.A passar till B. B lägger ut till C. C s: A is suitable for B. B adds to C. C strikes a diagonal passage between the dolls. D makes an arc run into the surface, receives and ends. Change the station by sun.
t.A passar till C medan B överlappar runt: A fits to C while B overlaps around C.
t.A slår en lång passning till B på högerk: A beats a long pass to B on the right. B is recorded in C in the penalty area. C will add A that has expired. A will play into B’s running behind the defence and B will end. D plays the next ball.
t.A spelar på B som kommer emot och lägger: A plays at B that comes back and goes back. A strikes deep to C, which plays to D, which ends the yard back to A-sex. Everyone follows their passage to the next corner.
t.A spelar till B som kommer emot. B lägge: A plays for B that comes against. B adds directly to C (third man), which strikes deep to D. D turns and drives back. Everybody rotates a cone.
t.A spelar till B, som scannar, tar emot p: A plays to B, which scans, receives on the rear foot, turns away from the defender and plays to C. C plays back and everyone rotates.
t.A startar från kön med boll. B, C och D: A starts from sex with ball. B, C and D stand at their cones.
t.A startar med boll. B och C står vid doc: A starts with the ball. B and C stand at the dolls.
t.A startar med boll. Dockorna bildar en m: A starts with the ball. The dolls form a wall on each side.
A starts on the left side with ball.
t.A: 1 passar till 2 och får tillbaka. B:: A: 1 fits to 2 and gets back. B: 1 plays out to 3. 2 makes an arc running outside, 3 plays deep into the run and 2 hits the ball into the penalty area. Everyone goes one step further.
t.A: 1 passar till 2. B: 2 passar till 3 v: A: 1 fits to 2. B: 2 fits to 3 at the stick. C: 3 plays the wall back to 2 that has passed. D: 2 is suitable for the next station. A: New passage up. Everyone follows their session.
t.A: 1 till 2. B: 2 till 3. C: 3 långt til: A: 1 v 2. B: 2 v 3. C: 3 far to 4. D: 4 v 2. E: 2 v 5. F: 5 far to 1. New ball starts when the previous one is at 3.
t.A: passa och få tillbaka. B: passa till: A: fit and get back. B: fit to the player who moves around the stick. C: Passing down. D: Long pass to the next stage. Follow your passage.
t.A: passning till spelaren som kommer fra: A: fit to the player who arrives between the dolls (B). C: On to the next between the dolls. D: New players arrive. E: Passing up to the top. G: Long passage back to start. Everyone follows their session.
t.A: vänster passar till mitten och får ti: A: The left fits to the middle and gets back. B: Same to the right. C: The center receives from the left and plays far to the right. D: Long passing back. Change the middle player after 45 seconds.

t.Anfall mot försvar - olika höjd försvars: Attacks against Defense - Various Height Defense Games
t.Anfall och kontring i fyra zoner: Attacks and contring in four zones
The attacking team is based on the centre-backs. Defense law presses to close one side. The two strikers of the defence are locked in the middle zone.
t.Anfallande lag startar med målvakten i d: Attacking teams start with the goalkeeper in the safe zone where no one can press. Each team has a player on each edge outside the pitch.
t.Anfallande lag startar med målvakten och: Attacking teams start with the goalkeeper and try to score goals. The Defense Law is just defending. Restart with the goalkeeper after goal, interruption or ball loss.
t.Anfallande lag startar varje anfall från: Attacking teams start each attack from their card line. No corners, insparks or inputs. Games in 3 minutes.
t.Anfallare runt straffområdet vid koner,: Attacks around the penalty area at cones, 2 defenders in the box and a goalkeeper
t.Anfallaren dribblar fram och tillbaka me: The attacker dribbles back and forth between the cones, the defender tries to stop.
t.Anfallaren dribblar från första till and: The attacker dribbles from first to second cone. The defender starts 5 m from the first cone.
t.Anfallaren driver mot försvararen och ta: The attacker pushes the defender and goes to the other side.
t.Anfallaren får 2 poäng för den mittersta: The attacker receives 2 points for the middle port and 1 for the side ports. The defender gets 1 point for the ball win.
t.Anfallaren får bara vara i målzonen och: The attacker may only be in the target zone and cannot score goals by himself.
t.Anfallaren får bollen med ryggen mot mål: The attacker gets the ball with his back to goal, turns and ends.
t.Anfallaren får inte vara förbi konlinjen: The attacker must not be past the line when the passage strikes – then it is offside and the next one on the turn. The proper tight run gives shots. Two strikers: one goes in depth, the other meets.
t.Anfallaren får poäng genom att driva gen: The attacker gets points by pushing through any port. The defender who wins the ball attacks directly. Play for 45 seconds and change.
t.Anfallaren försöker dribbla förbi och gö: The attacker tries to dribble past and score goals. The defender prevents shots or forces the ball out. Change the roles.
t.Anfallaren går eller joggar framåt med b: The attacker goes or jogs forward with the ball and the defender mirrors. Five repetitions, then change.
t.Anfallaren med boll driver mot försvarar: The striker with a ball pushes the defender. The companion chooses overlap or record space. Play 2 v 1 to shoot. Change roles after each attack.
t.Anfallaren passerar och avslutar. Spela: The attacker passes and ends. Play until the ball is out of play. The attacker changes the task after each attack.
t.Anfallaren ska avsluta. Försvararen får: The attacker will end. The defender receives 1 point for blocked shots and 2 for ball win.
t.Anfallaren ska driva över försvararens l: The attacker will push over the defender’s line. In the case of a break, the defender contemplates the opposite short side. Play until the ball is out of play. Change the roles.
t.Anfallaren ska göra mål, försvararen ska: The striker will score goals, the defender will win the ball and score goals in the second goal. Max eight seconds per duel.
t.Anfallaren ska vända och avsluta. Försva: The attacker will turn and end. The defender who wins the ball plays back to the fit for a point. Change roles after three attempts.
t.Anfallaren startar med boll, försvararen: The striker starts with ball, the defender from the side of the goal.
t.Anfallaren startar med bollen, försvarar: The striker starts with the ball, the defender 3 m in front.
t.Anfallaren startar sin djupledslöpning n: The attacker starts his in-depth run when the midfielder receives the right turn. Running should start diagonally and then straight to goals. Wrong timing = offside and the next.
t.Anfallaren vänder på första touchen och: The attacker turns the first touch and ends before the defender arrives.
t.Anfallarna anfaller mot mål tills det är: The attackers attack goals until 5 v 5. The defenders win the ball they contemplate the opposite goal.
t.Anfallarna avslutar på mål. Vid bollförl: The attackers finish goals. In case of ball loss, they should react immediately. Variants: Number of touch, mandatory passing through the jokings.
t.Anfallarna får 1 poäng för att driva öve: The attackers get 1 point to drive across the line. Defenders get 1 point for the ball win and 2 if they play the ball to the coach directly.
t.Anfallarna får 1 poäng för en spelvändni: The attackers receive 1 point for a game turn between the corridors and 3 points for goals after a turn of the last third. Defenders get 1 point for ball win and 3 for goals in a small goal.
The attackers can use all supporters. The defenders win the ball attack the goal and the others must win it back.
t.Anfallarna får bollen, spelar ut till ka: The attackers get the ball, play out to the edge and run into the box. The centre-backs fall in and follow the runs.
t.Anfallarna får en poäng för att driva öv: The attackers get a point to push over the lower line. Defenders get two points for ball win in an edge zone.
t.Anfallarna får poäng när de passar eller: The attackers get points when they fit or dribble through a conport. The defenders win the ball change the team roles. Most ports after three minutes win.
t.Anfallarna försöker göra mål i stora mål: The attackers try to score goals in the big goal. The defenders win the ball they contemplate against the two small goals. The next group starts immediately after the attack is over.
t.Anfallarna försöker göra mål innan den a: Attacks try to score goals before the second defender gets home. Win the defenders ball, they fit to the coach for a point.
t.Anfallarna försöker göra mål via väggspe: The attackers try to score goals via wall games. The defender should follow the player who fits and runs, not look for the ball. Broken returns give the defender a point.
t.Anfallarna försöker göra mål, försvararn: The attackers try to score goals, the defenders win the ball and fit back to the coach. The game is continuous. Variant: 3 v 5 or 8 v 6.
t.Anfallarna försöker göra mål. Försvararn: The attackers try to score goals. Defenders brake until the third is back. The defenders win the ball, they contemplate against a cone on the middle line.
t.Anfallarna försöker göra mål. Närmaste f: The attackers try to score goals. The closest defender presses and the other covers a bit behind. The defenders win the ball they contemplate against the small goals.
t.Anfallarna försöker göra mål. Vinner för: The attackers try to score goals. The defenders win the ball they contemplate towards the second goal. Change roles after each round.
t.Anfallarna försöker göra så många mål so: The attackers try to score as many goals as possible. The defenders win the ball they contemplate across the line. Direct goals and contring goals are counted twice.
t.Anfallarna gör mål i det stora målet. Fö: The attackers score goals in the big goal. The defenders score points by taking the ball to the mid-corridor.
t.Anfallarna gör mål i det stora målet. Vi: The attackers score goals in the big goal. The defenders win the ball they contemplate quickly against the mini goals or play to the neutral.
t.Anfallarna gör mål i ett av två mål. För: The attackers score goals in one of two goals. The defenders who win the ball must carry it through one of four diagonal gates to attack. Two touches, the last passage free.
t.Anfallarna gör poäng genom att ta bollen: The attackers score points by taking the ball over the middle line checked or score goals. Defenders contrate towards small goals at the ball win.
t.Anfallarna gör poäng på passningar i föl: The attackers score points on consecutive passages. Winner defenders the ball they can score goals in any mini goal.
t.Anfallarna har 8 sekunder på sig att avs: The attackers have 8 seconds to finish. Goals within 8 seconds give 2 points, after 1 point.
t.Anfallarna har tio sekunder på sig. Förs: The attackers have 10 seconds. Defenders and goalkeepers get 1 point for ball win or rescue.
t.Anfallarna har två inne och två på kante: The attackers have two inside and two on the edges. A neutral inside and two neutral at the goals always play with the team that has the ball.
t.Anfallarna håller bollen mot tre försvar: The strikers hold the ball against three defenders.
t.Anfallarna kombinerar för att göra mål i: The attackers combine to score goals in the big goal. The defenders win the ball scores the goals in a small goal or plays to their goalkeeper.
t.Anfallarna kombinerar runt boxen och för: The attackers combine around the box and try to create a shot against the two defenders and goalkeepers. Winner defends the ball, they play out to the middle player and the team starts over. Goal = 1 point, goal on the first touch = 2.
t.Anfallarna ska tvinga fram ett misstag i: The attackers must make a mistake within five seconds. If they win the ball, they can score goals. Playing the defenders continues the game.
t.Anfallarna spelar bara direkt. Mål direk: The attackers only play directly. Goals immediately after a pass from a player count double.
t.Anfallarna springer in en i taget, tackl: The attackers run in one at a time, the tackler faces halfway and makes a block stack.
t.Anfallarna startar 2 mot 1. Den andra fö: The attackers start 2 v 1. The second defender starts three seconds later.
t.Anfallarna startar hos målvakten, går 3: The attackers start with the goalkeeper, walk 3 v 1 in the first zone and then against two contring players. The waiting team is behind the goal.
t.Anfallarna står i sina riktiga positione: The attackers stand in their real positions and build up from their own goalkeeper on real floor space. Defenders are in their positions in the opposing team.
t.Anfallarna utmanar försvararna och spela: The attackers challenge the defenders and play the wall.
t.Anfallarna vinner bollen från tränaren o: The strikers win the ball from the coach and receive only three passes before shooting. The defenders who win the ball get 1 point by playing to the coach.
t.Anfallarna väljer själva hur många som g: The attackers choose how many people enter, from 1 v 3 up to 5 v 3, and attack a common goal. Tours in 3 minutes, then the team changes roles.
t.Anfallarna väljer skott, inlägg eller ko: The attackers choose shots, posts or short variants. Defense gets points if it clears or wins the ball.
t.Anfallarna: en kommer mot och en går på: The attackers: one comes toward and one goes in depth
t.Anfallet börjar alltid i egen försvarszo: The attack always begins in its own defense zone. The ball should be played forward from the player at the back to the attackers before shooting. Variations: minimum number of passes, three zones with fixed positions, extra points for play through the middle, time limit for defense.
t.Anfallet får bara göra mål om det har en: The attack may only score if it has a player in each section. Bonus goals when switching between channels. First to three goals.
t.Anfallslaget: stäng närmaste småmålet di: Attack: Close the nearest small target immediately
